node.title: Re: Can GTK3 be driven externally?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I am far from an expert on Gtk, but from some quick googling it sounds like one might set up a [https://developer.gnome.org/gio/stable/GSocketListener.html|GSocketListener] and work with [https://developer.gnome.org/gio/stable/GSocketConnection.html|GSocketConnection]s.
